title: Low balance alert
summary: Check your Paystack balance regularly and text the owner when it drops below a level you set.
description: Every few hours, checks your Paystack naira balance and, when it is below the amount you set, texts the owner so payouts do not fail for lack of funds. The owner's phone number is the tenant variable owner_phone.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: threshold
params.title: Alert below (naira)
params.description: Text the owner when the balance is below this many naira.

params.name: every_hours
params.title: Check every (hours)
params.description: How often to check, in hours.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The name of your Paystack connection.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

steps.name: Text the owner that the balance is low

input.sms: ='Low balance: Paystack holds NGN ' + string(double(steps.balance.output.balances.filter(b, b.currency == 'NGN')[0].balance) / 100.0) + ', below your alert level of NGN ' + string(double({{threshold:kobo}}) / 100.0) + '. Top up to keep payouts running.'
